validity.researcher_notes: P6842 (LEAP Expansion Phase 3) is confirmed to exist as a real, operating compression/looping expansion on the LEAP Gathering System in Louisiana. The row is correctly classified as a gas transmission/gathering expansion. EIA and operator disclosures confirm capacity (200 MMcf/d), in-service year (2024, June), and current operating status. The row describes an incremental expansion, not a new standalone pipeline, which explains LengthKnown=0. No duplicates identified in the roster; P5113 (LEAP mainline), P5114 (Phase 1), P6773 (Phase 2) are distinct phases. DT Midstream (the operator/owner) is correctly identified.

LEAP is a Louisiana-regulated intrastate gathering system (FERC issued a gathering affirmation in September 2024 per S&P article context). Pressure specifications typically appear in FERC orders or tariffs for interstate lines; LEAP's intrastate status and limited public filings make this difficult to source. Searched: EIA workbook, operator disclosure, trade press. Pressure data not available in reviewed sources.

cross_row_leads.facts: LEAP mainline (P5113): 150 mi, 36-inch, 1000 MMcf/d, 1978 in-service. S&P Global context indicates Phase 3 (P6842) is an expansion of this system.

LEAP Expansion Phase 2: 400 MMcf/d, January 2024 in-service per S&P Global and EIA. Distinct from Phase 3 (200 MMcf/d, June 2024).
